title: Integrability of Gaussian affine monomials
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $a\in\mathbb R^n$, let $s\in\mathbb R$, and let $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$ be a finite set of coordinates. The function $y\mapsto\prod_{i\in S}(a_i+s y_i)$ is integrable under the product of $n$ standard Gaussian measures.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of coordinates
